# Mathematics: Chapter 13 — Statistics — Formula Sheet

## Class Mark

\[
x_i = \frac{\text{Upper Class Limit} + \text{Lower Class Limit}}{2}
\]

## Mean of Grouped Data ($\bar{x}$)

### 1. Direct Method
\[
\bar{x} = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^n f_i x_i}{\sum_{i=1}^n f_i}
\]

Where:
- $f_i$ — Frequency of the $i$-th class
- $x_i$ — Class mark of the $i$-th class

### 2. Assumed Mean Method
\[
\bar{x} = a + \frac{\sum_{i=1}^n f_i d_i}{\sum_{i=1}^n f_i}
\]

Where:
- $a$ — Assumed mean chosen from class marks $x_i$
- $d_i = x_i - a$ — Deviation of $x_i$ from $a$

### 3. Step-Deviation Method
\[
\bar{x} = a + \left( \frac{\sum_{i=1}^n f_i u_i}{\sum_{i=1}^n f_i} \right) \times h
\]

Where:
- $u_i = \frac{x_i - a}{h}$
- $h$ — Class size (width)

## Mode of Grouped Data

### Formula
\[
\text{Mode} = l + \left( \frac{f_1 - f_0}{2f_1 - f_0 - f_2} \right) \times h
\]

Where:
- $l$ — Lower limit of the modal class (class with maximum frequency)
- $h$ — Size of the class interval (assuming equal class sizes)
- $f_1$ — Frequency of the modal class
- $f_0$ — Frequency of the class preceding the modal class
- $f_2$ — Frequency of the class succeeding the modal class

## Median of Grouped Data

### Formula
\[
\text{Median} = l + \left( \frac{\frac{n}{2} - cf}{f} \right) \times h
\]

Where:
- $l$ — Lower limit of the median class (class whose cumulative frequency is just greater than or equal to $n/2$)
- $n = \sum f_i$ — Total number of observations
- $cf$ — Cumulative frequency of the class preceding the median class
- $f$ — Frequency of the median class
- $h$ — Class size

## Empirical Relationship Among Measures of Central Tendency

\[
3 \text{ Median} = \text{Mode} + 2 \text{ Mean}
\]

Rearranged forms:
\[
\text{Mode} = 3 \text{ Median} - 2 \text{ Mean}
\]
\[
\text{Mean} = \frac{3 \text{ Median} - \text{Mode}}{2}
\]
